subject: Staged Adoption Playlist, Owner SLAs & Implementation Timeline
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@clarityhealth.io>, Rob Matthews <rob.matthews@clarityhealth.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Staged Adoption Playlist, Owner SLAs & Implementation Timeline

Hi Elena and Rob,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I pulled together a compact, staged adoption playlist that ties milestone owners to an SLA for decision/response windows — our goal is to reduce friction during the first 90 days while keeping go/no-go gates clear.

Attached: MAP-v1.xlsx (staged milestones, owners, acceptance criteria) and Onboarding-RACI.pdf (roles & escalation contacts). High-level notes below:

- Week 0 (Prep): Kickoff, account access, test data handoff — owner: Clarity engineering (Rob) — SLA: 3 business days to confirm access.
- Week 1-2 (Core Integration): API keys, model selection, test prompts — owner: Mina (Redwood) & Clarity eng — SLA: 5 business days for API smoke tests.
- Week 3-6 (Validation): Eval sets, quality checks, sample traffic — owner: Marissa (CS) — SLA: 7 business days for acceptance; decision gate at Week 6.
- Week 7-12 (Ramp & Ops): Autoscaling tuning, observability, rollback plan — owner: Ben (Ops) — SLA: 5 business days for tuning iterations.

Also proposed: a weekly 30-min operating cadence for the first 8 weeks and a short escalation path (see RACI). We can shorten or extend SLAs if your internal reviewers need more runway.

Action items for this week (please reply inline):
- Rob: confirm we have the test account + SSO details by Thursday 11/25.
- Elena: confirm the internal acceptance reviewer(s) for Week 6 decisions.
- Clarity team: please review attached MAP and send any redlines to the doc or reply here.

I’ll schedule a 30-min kickoff for Monday 11/24 — if that doesn’t work we can move to Tuesday.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
mina.haddad@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0199

Thanks Mina — this looks very practical. A few quick clarifications from our side:

1) Acceptance reviewer: I’ll loop in Dr. Patel (clinical QA) as the primary Week 6 reviewer; he may take up to 10 business days for a detailed review. Is that ok or do we need a faster path?
2) Test accounts: Rob confirms he can provision service accounts by 11/24 but needs a short checklist for required scopes.

We agree to the weekly 30-min cadence. Monday 11/24 at 10:00 PT works for Rob and me.
